name: Oberostendorf (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, red and white, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Oberostendorf (a white bird and a star on red).
history: Municipal flag of Oberostendorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Oberostendorf arms — bird and star on red
